n-k-k4-01.title: Beeksisa gabaabsame
n-k-k4-01.goal: Cuunfaa gabaabaa hiriyaa kutaa beeksisa mana kitaabaa wajjin wal bira qabi, sararoota wanta beeksisni jedhu jijjiiran argi, tokko sirreessi.
n-k-k4-01.material:
Hiriyaan kutaa haaraan 현우 seerota mana kitaabaa mana barumsaa gaafatti. 현우 beeksisa armaan gadii dubbisee cuunfaa gabaabaa ishee barreesse.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.
n-k-k4-01.thinking.1: Garagalcha madda wajjin sarara sarara wal bira qabuu
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 fi 돌려주다 beekaa
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: Cuunfaan 현우 armaan gadii. Sararoonni tokko tokko beeksisa irraa wanta garaagara jedhu. Isaan keessaa tokko filadhu.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Cuunfaa sarara tokko tokkoon fudhadhu, sarara wal simu beeksisa keessatti argi.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sarara hundaaf gaafadhu: beeksisni sirriitti kana jedhaa, moo cuunfaan guyyaa, dheerina yeroo, ykn haala jijjiire?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Sararoota guyyaa, lakkoofsa guyyaa, ykn jecha 'kamiyyuu' qaban mirkaneessi.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni 2, 5 fi 6 dogoggora. Beeksisni 일요일은 쉽니다 (Dilbata cufaa) jedha, dhorkaan kitaaba liqeeffachuu guyyoota kitaabni itti harkifate hangaa qofa turuu, fi fuudhaan bishaan qoodoo qabu qofa eeyyamama. Sararoonni 1, 3 fi 4 beeksisa wajjin simatu.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Sararri dhumaa cuunfaa gabaabaa fi hiriyummaa dha. Maaliif hiriyaa kutaa haaraaf rakkoo ta'a?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara 6 sarara dhumaa beeksisaa cinaa kaa'i.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jecha xiqqoo beeksisa keessa dhugaatiin kam eeyyamama daangessu argi, cuunfaan eegee jira moo hin jiru ilaali.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: Dhugaatii tokkoon illee fiduu hin dandeessu jettee yaadti.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Cuunfaan dhugaatii hin dhorku; dhugaatii hundumaa eeyyama, kunis dogoggora faallaa dha.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: Dhugaatiin guyyoota hojii qofa eeyyamama jettee yaadti.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Cuunfaan waa'ee guyyaa dhugaatii homaa hin jedhu. Rakkoon haala dhugaatii kam irratti hanqateera.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: Dhugaatii hin eeyyamamne fiduu dandeessi, sababni isaa haalli dhiifameera.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: Mana kitaabaa nyaata fi dhugaatii lamaanuu akka fiduu dandeessu jettee yaadti.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: Sararri dhugaatii qofa irratti dha; nyaanni isa keessatti hin eeramne.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Cuunfaan jecha dogoggoraa tokkollee malee dogoggora ta'uu danda'a: 아무거나 haala (뚜껑이 있는 물병만) haqe. Haala dhiifamuun seera jijjiiruuf karaa beekamaa dha.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarara dhugaatii (sarara dhumaa cuunfaa) Afaan Koreaatiin deebisii barreessi, beeksisa wajjin wal fakkaatu. Dubbii ulfaataa -요 fayyadami.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara dhumaa beeksisaa deebi'ii dhugaatii kam eeyyamamu argi.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Haala kam sarara cuunfaa dhaban? Deebisii kaa'i.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Sarara koo qoodoo fi fuudhaa bishaan lamaanuu eegaa?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Barataan haaraan sarara koo qofa dubbise wanta sirrii fiduu?

n-k-k4-02.title: Keekii bilisaa ayyaana dhalootaaf?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Papiyaa tokko ergaa hiriyaa wajjin walitti hidhi, dhugaawwan karoorri hojjetu moo hin hojjetne murteessan hojjedhu, hiriyaa kee maal gochuu akka qabdu itti himi.
n-k-k4-02.material:
Har'a 수요일 dha. Hiriyaan kee 하나 ergaa ergite, papiyaa kaafee illee siif kenniteetti.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자: "내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게."
n-k-k4-02.thinking.1: Seera guyyoota irratti hojii irra oolchuu
n-k-k4-02.thinking.2: Daangaa guyyaa papiyaa keessa dhokate hubachuu
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Odeeffannoon LAMA kam karoorri 하나 hojjetuu moo hin hojjetne murteessa? Lamaanuu filadhu.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Dhugaawwan kam walitti qabamanii guyyaa si kennu?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dhugaa hundaa mirkaneessi: karoorri 하나 kaafee osoo hin gahin dura kufuu danda'aa?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: Guyyaan dhaloota 하나 Sanbata dha, kanaaf seerri Dilbataa karoora kanaaf dhimma hin qabu.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: Kun kaafee irratti gochamuu qaba, garuu karoorri ammallee hojjetuu danda'uu moo hin danda'u hin murteessu.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Kun sababa karooraa dha, seera mirkaneessuu qabdu miti.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Seerri galmee fi guyyaan dhaloota walitti qabamuu qaba: guyyaa dhaloota Sanbata + 'guyyaa 3 dura' daangaa kenna, daangaan sunis dhiyoo ta'uu danda'a.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Fakkeenya papiyaa hojii irra oolchi. Har'a 수요일 dha. Guyyaa dhaloota Sanbataa tiif, guyyaan dhumaa galmee godhuu kami?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Fakkeenya papiyaa akka bifaatti fayyadami: guyyaa dhaloota irraa, lakkoofsa guyyaa wal fakkaatu duubatti lakkaa'i.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Guyyoota tartiibaan Sanbata, Jimaata, Kamisa, ... barreessi, lakkoofsa sirrii irratti dhaabbadhu.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: Kamisa Sanbata dura guyyaa 2 qofa dha, kanaaf duraanuu baayyee booda dha.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: Salasa Sanbata dura guyyaa 4 dha. Fakkeenya wajjin lakkaa'i: guyyaa dhaloota Jimaata Salasa kenna.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: Wiixata Sanbata dura guyyaa 5 dha; fakkeenya papiyaa (guyyaa dhaloota Jimaata, Salasa) guyyaa 3 dura agarsiisa.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Jimaata irraa Salasa guyyaa 3 dura dha, kanaaf Sanbata irraa Roobii fageenya wal fakkaatu dha. Har'a Roobii dha, kanaaf har'a guyyaa dhumaa dha.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Ergaa gabaabaa 하나 tiif Afaan Koreaatiin (dubbii hiriyummaa -요) barreessi. Maal gochuu qabdu fi yoom, fi maaliif himi.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Maal gochuu akka qabdu (maal, akkamitti) himi, sababa -아서/-어서 ykn -니까 tiin dabali.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Barreeffamni koo har'a, wanta gochuu qabdu, fi sababa jedhaa?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 하나 erga dubbisee booda maal gochuu akka qabdu beekaa?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.modelNote.0: Har'a, waamicha, fi sababa maqaa kenna.

n-k-k4-03.title: Tikkeetii garee tiif
n-k-k4-03.goal: Ergaa hiriyaa seera madaallii dhokate qabu gara haalota sirrii tti jijjiiri, garee baayyee wal simatan ijaari, tokko Afaan Koreaatiin gabaasi.
n-k-k4-03.material:
Hiriyaan kee 서연 tikkeetii bituu dura siif ergite:

"놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요."

(1만 원 = 10,000원, so 6만 원 = 60,000원. Gareen ati tarreessitu hojjettoota fi daa'imman qofa dha.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원
n-k-k4-03.thinking.0: Seera lakkoofsa lama walitti hidhu dubbisuu
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Lakkoofsota, 명, 어른, 어린이 fi -까지 beeka
n-k-k4-03.prereq.2: 만 (10,000) gatii akka 3만 8천 원 keessatti beeka
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: '어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요' kun maal sitti hima?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duraan seera kana nama guddaa tokkoon yaali: daa'imman meeqa deemuu danda'u?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Itti aansee nama guddaa lama fudhadhuu lakkoofsi akkamitti guddachaa akka deemu ilaali.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: Nama guddaan tokko daa'imman hanga lamaa fudhachuu danda'a.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Nama guddaan hundi daa'imman sirriitti lama fudhachuu qaba.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: '까지' daangaa olaanaa kenna, lakkoofsa dirqamaa miti.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.c: Daa'imman hanga namoota guddaa qofa ta'uu danda'u.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Seerichi nama guddaa tokkoof daa'ima lama jedha, tokko miti.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Daa'imni hundi nama guddaa lama waliin deemuu barbaada.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: Kunis seera jijjiira: asitti nama guddaan tokko daa'ima lama fudhachuu danda'a.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' daangaa kaa'a: nama guddaan tokko daa'ima hanga lamaa fudhata, kanaaf nama guddaa 2 waliin daa'imman hanga 4 deemuu danda'u.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Garee 3 haalawwan ergaa keessa jiran hundumaa guutan, tokkoon tokkoon isaanii lakkoofsa namoota guddaa adda ta'e qabu, bari. a = namoota guddaa, c = daa'imman.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Duraan haalawwan sana jecha ofii keetiin, sarara tokkoon tokkoon barreessi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: a = 2 irraa jalqabi, lakkoofsa daa'imman seera daa'immanii fi seera nama 5 guutan barbaadi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Xiqqaate nama guddaa tokkoo fi daa'ima tokko.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Xiqqaate nama guddaa tokko si barbaachisa, ergaan immoo xiqqaate daa'ima tokko jedha (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Nama guddaa tokkoof daa'ima lamaa hin caalu.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Daa'imman baay'ee dha: nama guddaan tokko hanga lama fudhachuu danda'a (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ergaan nama 5 ykn isaa ol barbaada (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: Fakkeenyaaf nama guddaa 2 + daa'ima 3 = 38,000 won; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Garee hedduun ni mijaa'a sababni ergaan daangaa kenna malee garee sirrii tokko hin kennine.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Garee kee keessaa TOKKO filadhuu 서연 barreeffama gabaabaa Afaan Koreaatiin (-요 ulfina qabeessa) ergi: duraan namoota guddaa, itti aansee daa'imman, achiis gatii waliigalaa. Lakkoofsota akka lakkoofsaatti ykn jechoota lakkoofsa Koreaatiin barreessi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Garee armaan olii tokko fayyadami: lakkoofsonni lamaan kam?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duraan namoota guddaa, itti aansee daa'imman, achiis waliigala won'iin jedhi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Lakkoofsonni barreeffama kootii garee ani ijaare tokkoof ni walfakkaataa?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: Yaada firaa 서연: '어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.' Karoorri kun haala isa kam cabsa?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Karoora kana haala ergaa keessa jiru hundumaan tokko tokkoon qori.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Herregni hundi ofiin herregi; lakkoofsota karoora keessa barreeffaman irratti hin hirkatin.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: Namoonni guddaan shan daa'imman hanga kudhan fudhachuu danda'u, karoorri immoo lama qofa qaba.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: Namoonni 7 jiru, kanaaf seerri nama 5 guutameera.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Karoorri daa'ima 2 qaba, kanaaf seerri xiqqaate daa'ima tokko guutameera.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Tikeetiin dhugumaan 62,000 won kaffala, daangaa caala.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: Namoonni guddaan shan 50,000 won, daa'imman lamaan 12,000 won kaffalu, kunis 62,000 dha, 60,000 caala. Lakkoofsi karoora keessa jiru dogoggora. Yeroo hundumaa waliigala ofiin lakkaa'i malee hin garagalchin.

n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Wanta hanga ammaa dubbiste qofa fayyadamuun murteessi.
n-k-k4-04.title: Dhiyeessii nyaata laafaa
n-k-k4-04.goal: Mari gabaabaa sadarkaan sadarkaan dubbisi, hiikni kee yeroo hima haaraan dhufu jijjiiri, achiis namni tokko illee akka hin tilmaamne deebisi.
n-k-k4-04.material: Kaafeteeriyaa mana barumsaa keessa hiriyaa kee 지우 waliin jirta. Bar-bariin buskuutii baasta.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Kutaa tokkoon tokkoon dubbisi, hiika carraa guddaa qabu filadhu, achiis itti fufi.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Deebii jalqabaa booda jechoota sababa ykn yeroo kennan barbaadi.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 지우 carraa guddaa maal jechuu barbaadde?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Hiikni lamaan danda'ama: 괜찮아요 dhiyeessii fudhachuu ykn didu danda'a. Deebiin gabaabaan tokko hin gahu.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wanti nyaata laafaa biraa hin eeru; dhiyeessii kee qofa deebiseera.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Buskuutiin maal akka ta'e gaafachaa jirti.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Deebiin ishee gabaabaa fi ulfina qabeessa, gaaffii miti.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Amma 지우 carraa guddaa maal jechuu barbaadde?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: '-아서요' sababa kenna. Ciree sa'aatii laaqanaa baay'ee nyaachuun 'galatoomi, hin barbaadu' hiika caalaa mijaa'aa taasisa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Buskuutii muraasa barbaaddi, sababni isheen laaqana baay'ee nyaatteef.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Laaqanni guddaan nyaachuu dhiisuuf sababa dha, kanaaf didaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ulfina qabeessatti didaa jirti, sababni isheen quufteef.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Sababa nyaachuu waliin wal-qabatu deebiste, kanaaf dhaggeeffateera.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Amma fakkiin guutuun ifaadha: amma lakki, boodarra immoo eeyyee ta'uu danda'a. 괜찮아요 jalqabaa qofti kana agarsiisuu hin dandeenye.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Amma miti, garuu boodarra buskuutii tokko ta'uu danda'a.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Boodarra tokko kadhatti, kanaaf bara baraan hin didu.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Boodarra tokko si kadhatti, kanaaf akka qabdu barbaaddi.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: 괜찮아요 'eeyyee, gaarii dha' ykn 'galatoomi, hin barbaadu' jechuu danda'a. Jechoonni isa booda dhufan (sababni, yeroon) kam akka ta'e murteessu. Deebiin ulfina qabeessi illee ifa hin ta'in danda'a.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Hiriyaa kee 민호 nyaata laafaa si dhiyeessuu. Deebiin kam salphaatti dogoggoraan hubatamuu danda'a?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Deebii tokkoon tokkoon gaafadhu: erga dubbifamee booda, amma nyaata laafaa 민호 kennuu akka qabu ni beekamaa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Deebii tokkoon tokkoon ergaa barreeffamaa sagalee malee fakkaadhu: 민호 haala faallaa lamaan dubbisuu danda'aa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: 괜찮아요 qofti eeyyee ykn lakki jedhamee dhaggeeffamuu danda'a. Didaan ykn fudhatiin jecha ifa qabu (안 먹을게요, 주세요) hin danda'amu.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 nyaata laafaa si dhiyeessa. Amma hin barbaadu, garuu boodarra barbaaduu dandeessa. Afaan Koreaatiin deebisi (haasaa -요 ulfina qabeessa) akka 민호 dogoggoraan hin hubanne.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ifatti amma akka hin nyaanne jedhi, sababa gabaabaas kenni.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hima tokko dabali waan boodarra gochuu dandeessu irratti.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ani amma lakki akkan jedhu 민호 ni beekaa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ani boodarra eeyyee jechuu akkan danda'u 민호 ni beekaa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Amma ni didaa, sababa kenna, boodarra ni kadhata.

n-k-k4-05.title: Mana yeroo booda ga'uu: karoora tokko, dubbisaan lama
n-k-k4-05.goal: Oduu wal-fakkaatu 할머니 fi obboleessa kee xiqqaaf, sadarkaa haasaa Afaan Koreaa tokkoon tokkoon isaaniif jijjiirtee himi.
n-k-k4-05.material: Har'a shaakala garee qabda, kanaaf sa'aatii 7:00 mana ni ga'ita, yeroo baramaa caalaa boodatti. 할머니 barruu ni kaa'ita, obboleessa kee xiqqaa (동생) immoo ergaa ni kaa'ita, isa 반말 itti fayyadamta.
n-k-k4-05.thinking.2: Jechoota sadarkaa haasaa adda ta'an hubachuu
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ergawwan hima tokkoon tokkoon dubbisi, hima tokkoon tokkoon akkamitti akka xumuramu ilaali.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gochima nyaata sa'aatii 할머니 kan ta'e akkasumas xumura isaanii ilaali.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Himni lamaan akka hiriyaa ykn nama xiqqaa waliin dubbattu xumuramu, 할머니 waliin akka dubbattu miti.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: Himni jalqabaa haasaa laafaatti kufa (올게); himni lamaan wal hin simatu.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Ulfina qaba, garuu 먹어요 akka 드세요 nyaata 할머니 hin kabaju.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: 할머니 waliin himni hundi -요 ykn xumura kabajaa barbaada, nyaanni ishee gochima kabajaa 드세요 fudhata. Xumurri laafaan (가, 먹어, 올게) hiriyaaf fi nama xiqqaaf ta'a, sadarkaa walitti makuun barruu tokko keessatti ofeeggannoo dhabuu fakkaata.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Barruu kee 할머니 dhaaf Afaan Koreaatiin barreessi. Sa'aatii 7:00 mana akka ga'xu fi sababa isaa himi.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: 할머니 waamuudhaan jalqabi, achiis yeroo fi sababa himi.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ani 할머니 waameera, hima hundas ulfinaan xumureera?
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.modelNote.0: Ulfina qabeessa, sababa, yeroo fi sarara of eeggannoo.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.prompt: Amma ergaa obboleessa kee xiqqaaf (동생) 반말 itti fayyadamtee barreessi. Oduu wal-fakkaatu himi: sa'aatii 7:00 mana ni ga'ita. Wanta inni akka godhu barbaaddu tokko dabali.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.0: Yeroo wal-fakkaatu himi, garuu xumura 동생 waliin fayyadamtu fayyadami.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.1: Gaaffii gabaabaa tokko dabali (먹어, 해 줘, 기다려 ...).
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Oduun kun barruu 할머니 dhaaf barreeffame wal-fakkaatuu?
